items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans and is likely to miss a few weeks, per Rapoport and Schefter.
items.implication: Eagles TE committee or elevated secondary options; Saquon/WRs may see slight target bump

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging Monday on dislocated left elbow and will consult experts per protocol; Marcus Mariota expected to start Sunday vs Seattle.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow (prior history); further evaluation ongoing
items.implication: Mariota starts; Commanders offense downgrade, monitor WR/TE usage under backup

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson expects QB Caleb Williams to be week-to-week with the hamstring injury suffered Sunday; MRI done Monday morning and he will likely miss some time. Same left hamstring he injured in college in 2022.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring pull; coach update after MRI
items.implication: Tyson Bagent expected to start; monitor Bears pass-catchers volume and efficiency under backup

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured his back Sunday; spent night in New Jersey and returning to GB while team evaluates treatment and recovery timeframe.
items.why: Back injury after head/neck scare; overnight hospital
items.implication: Unavailable short-term; monitor Packers WR depth (Watson/Wicks etc)

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12 yesterday. Through two weeks opportunities Bucky 36 vs Gainwell 12. Sean Tucker active but 0 offensive snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as lead back; Gainwell clear secondary
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, routes heavily favoring Irving

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE weapon-deficient offense needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + need for explosiveness with Brown out
items.implication: Henderson role expansion likely; Stevenson still involved but docked

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger but hope is minor injury; he played through it after missing most of first half.
items.why: Stinger on first play; returned second half with neck roll
items.implication: Likely available Week 3 but monitor practice; Tank Bigsby saw work in absence

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan said he did not believe WR Mike Evans’ hip injury was serious and he could have returned in the fourth quarter if needed. Demarcus Robinson has high-ankle sprain.
items.implication: Expected to be fine moving forward; low long-term concern

items.text: Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE for Week 2 after GTD optimism and flak jacket possibility. Played through for 3 catches.
items.implication: Played limited/decoy role but available; full practice week should help Week 3

items.text: RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive Week 2. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason advice.
items.implication: JK Dobbins paces backfield; Coleman/Badie also involved
items.opportunity: RB snaps/carries to Dobbins and backups

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT, Michael Pittman (foot) OUT. Olave (hamstring) and Burrow (back) expected/active. Nacua (hip) true GTD. Harvey not expected.
items.implication: Ravens WR targets to Bateman/others; Colts WR to Bernard etc; Olave/Burrow full-ish; Nacua monitor MNF
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for backups behind OUT players

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps, David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29-of-67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.implication: Gadsden (or remaining TE) elevated routes/snaps if injuries linger; monitor Chargers TE

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points per Late-Round model. Berry: RIDE. OR. DIE.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 with high floor/ceiling on volume

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a handful of WRs worse (Johnston, Dyami Brown, Addison etc).
items.implication: Efficiency concerns despite opportunity; monitor role/scheme
